notes.title: Free Desperados III update lets you switch characters, adds makeshift level editor
notes.content:
Rock-hard, cowboy-themed tactical stealth game Desperados III has just got a free update that lets you mix and match characters on missions to shake up the gameplay, as well as adding "level editing cheats" to design your own wild west missions.

Developer Mimimi Productions and publisher THQ Nordic have announced in a press release that on December 9 the game's new 'bounty mode' would let players choose freely from the five playable characters on "almost every major mission" - rather than simply controlling whichever dusty-booted desperados are pre-selected for that chapter. The idea is that you can now pick out characters with abilities particularly suited for each of the game's pretty challenging missions and make things a little easier - or deliberately take a team hopelessly ill-equipped for the job to upgrade your challenge to near-masochistic levels.

The level editing cheats, meanwhile, let you wipe levels clean and build your own missions from scratch, with all the game's weapons, enemies, and environmental items in your toolbox. Once you've created a custom mission using the cheats, all the changes are stored in your save file, so you can also share your creations with fellow frontier tacticians.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Desperados III Adds Bounty Mode and "Level Editor Light" In Free Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33465443/611aa3cc13437b2c2729cbd382b10f8ec772a448.jpg[/img]

Vienna, Austria / Munich, Germany, December 9th, 2020: Desperados III gets another free update - the Bounty Mode is now part of the game and lets you choose, which of the five Desperados you want to play in almost every major mission.* Either you make it easier for yourself or spice the mission up a bit - or you try to finish the game with Hector all over the place!
[i]* similar to the Baron's Challenges, this mode will unlock during the second chapter[/i]

Also, the newly activated "[b]Level Editing Cheats[/b]" allow you to create your own mission setups and share the savegames with all other Desperados III players. Basically, it's a level editor light. By using the cheat codes, players can easily clean a map and then spawn all types of enemies in any location on the map and have fun by placing different objects throughout the level. You want to use 20 dynamite crates and 10 Gatling guns in Flagstone for maximum chaos? You got it! Get creative and share your own mission setups as savegame files with other players!

More info and a video tutorial explaining the tool in detail can be found here: https://www.mimimi.games/desperados-iii-level-editing-cheats/
Direct link to the tutorial videos: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL9AjxFSXaZ2yIAPzWdCuaM2rD_aTZQFT1

Watch the Trailer:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xQdzoGl4kac

[b]And now, for some shameless cross-promotion! [/b]
Our friends at Honig Studios and HandyGames released their non-violent spaghetti-western stealth game "[b]El Hijo - A Wild West Tale[/b]" a few days ago. If you love sneaking around in the deserts and towns of the wild wild west, you should take a look! Shameless cross-promotion might be unforgiven, but for a fistful of dollars all you good, bad, and ugly greenhorns can duel in the sun with 'El Hijo', so show some true grit and take the stagecoach to 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/853050

For a few dollars more, you can rob Desperados III after its magnificent seventh update, 40% off!
[i]*starting tonight on steam as part of The Game Awards Sale[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/610370/

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Another FREE CONTENT UPDATE introducing 4 new Baron's Challenge missions!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33465443/0206f0c757b16b0cd13e3155b91c131c21f40d83.jpg[/img]

[b]A Cat, a Chicken, a Dog and a Speedrun Contest: Another Free Update for Desperados III[/b]
 
Vienna, Austria/ Munich, Germany, August 20th, 2020: A cat, a dog and a chicken walk into the town. In the end, Doc McCoy is free! It may sound like the beginning of an epic joke, but is indeed the description of one of the four new Baron's Challenges, added to Desperados III for free. In the Rescue Aid Society Challenge, you take control of Stella the Cat, Agent Floofs, and Sergeant Cluckers! These three unlikely heroes might end McCoy's imprisonment if their skills are used wisely. What do the free challenges have to offer? Take a look: 

[list]
[*][b]Three Men with No Name[/b]: Where is Waldo? Identify three specific guards among the crowd of supposed doppelgangers on the map – and kill them! 
[*][b]Bear Trap Triplets[/b]: We all know how much Hector loves his little Bianca. One can only imagine what he could do with three of them... why not put it to a test? 
[*][b]Best Served Cold[/b]: Some poor guy didn't know who the Baron was and cheated him. The Baron wants him found in a crowded market place and brought to the docks – dead or alive. 
[*][b]Rescue Aid Society[/b]: Alas! Doc McCoy is being held prisoner in the Bayous. Isabelle's cat Stella, a dog, and a chicken have formed a special animal commando to rescue the Doc.
[/list]

Watch the Trailer: https://youtu.be/lPbcNKrK4L8

Find the full patch notes here: http://n.thq.com/k95e30r5jcS

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33465443/20e305b446443fb7c43d5f5b29212abb1b3b8110.jpg[/img]

[b]Speedrun Contest[/b]
 
Mimimi Games and THQ Nordic are launching the first Desperados III Speedrun Contest. From August 20th until August 23rd any interested player can participate and submit a video. 

[b]Here are the rules: [/b]
[list]
[*]Level: Flagstone
[*]Difficulty: Normal 
[*]Settings: Please reset the options to default in the options menu. However, you can use your own control schemes.
[*]Challenge: Complete the level as fast as you can without triggering any alarms.
[*]Video: To participate you have to record your best speedrun playthrough of the described challenge above, then upload it on YouTube and send the uncut (!) video (also showing the Replay Screen and Mission Stats Screen upon mission completion) as link to speedrun@mimimi.games. Please note: If the Mimimi Games and THQ Nordic jury sees any evidence of video editing, cheating or disregard of rules, the submitted video and respective player will be disqualified. Please read the full set of rules here: http://n.thq.com/376l30r5aV7 or download it here: http://n.thq.com/fS1w30r5jd0
[*]Time: The contest starts right now and submission will close on August 23rd, 2020, 11:59 PM PDT / August 24th, 2020, 8:59 CEST.
[*]While submitting their speedrun videos, players agree that these videos will be published and/or shared on social media by Mimimi Games / THQ Nordic
[/list]

[b]What can you win? [/b]

[b]1st Place: [/b]
[list]
[*]A physical Desperados III Collector’s Edition (please note: THQ Nordic can only send physical prizes to countries with a working postal service)
[*]A digital key for Desperados III to share the game with your friends A digital key for the Desperados III Season Pass
[*]One digital key for another THQ Nordic game like Darksiders Genesis, Wreckfest, Destroy All Humans! or SpongeBob SquarePants: Battle for Bikini Bottom - Rehydrated
[/list]

[b]2nd - 5th Place:[/b]
[list]
[*]A digital key for Desperados III to share the game with your friends
[*]A digital key for the Desperados III Season Pass 
[*]One digital key for another THQ Nordic game like Darksiders Genesis, Wreckfest, Destroy All Humans! or SpongeBob SquarePants: Battle for Bikini Bottom - Rehydrated
[/list]

[b]All other participants:[/b]
[list]
[*]A chance to win either a digital key for the Desperados III Season Pass or one digital key for another THQ Nordic game like Darksiders Genesis, Wreckfest, Destroy All Humans! or SpongeBob SquarePants: Battle for Bikini Bottom - Rehydrated
[/list]

Find the full set of rules here: http://n.thq.com/376l30r5aV7 and download it here: http://n.thq.com/fS1w30r5jd0

Stay tuned!

notes.title: The Baron's Call: Free Update for Desperados III with new content released today
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33465443/13ed7e87b1a15e1cedc3497b8028f7ed05529157.png[/img]

Vienna, Austria/ Munich, Germany, July 23rd, 2020: The critically acclaimed Desperados III isn't challenging enough for you yet? Well, Mimimi Games has got you covered with a free update for all platforms today: introducing the "Baron's Challenge Mission Pack #1", containing four brand new Baron's Challenges for Flagstone, Mayor Higgins' Estate, Eagle Falls, and the Casa DeVitt. 

Each one has a new special challenge for you: 
[list]
[*] Vanishing Act: A certain snake-oil salesman is peddling his wares at the town square of Flagstone. Make him disappear. 
[*] Untitled Voodoo Mission: Isabelle is about to crash Mayor Higgins' wedding, and she has brought a LOT of mind control darts. 
[*] Public Transportation: Two dead men must be carried to the Eagle Falls train station. The guards won't shoot on sight, but if they see a body... 
[*] Bird Hunting: Doc is perched on the roof of Casa DeVitt, with plenty of ammo and five targets on his list. The party is still going. Happy hunting. 
[/list]

Watch the Trailer: https://youtu.be/nZT3rPHS56Q

Additionally to the new content, Mimimi Games has also improved the game in many ways, for example offering a Borderless Fullscreen Mode or Enhanced Renderscale Support, as well as support of the Tobii Eyetracking Tool. 
Find the full patch notes here: http://n.thq.com/PVVx30qZX4M

The [b]official Desperados Pen & Paper RPG[/b] is available as a free download. 
Watch the  trailer: https://youtu.be/xnh82ttKIw0
Download here: https://www.drivethrurpg.com/product/316116/Desperados-A-Pen-and-Paper-Roleplaying-Game 

[b]Free Demo available! [/b]
You can't wait to try Desperados III for yourself? Well, here is your chance: A free demo with two and a half levels from our story-driven, hardcore tactical stealth game is available here on Steam. Check it out and see if Desperados III will become your favorite game. 

Get the demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/610370/Desperados_III/

Stay tuned!
